text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I shall confer with you again in two days.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day after I made that promise
with Eishin
Flash. Now, in order to help
her get the
"experience" she's after...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm having a meeting with Tracen
Academy's
student council president
and Triple Crown
Champion, Symboli
Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I beg your pardon, but could you please
repeat
that?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Are you truly asking me, the Emperor
Symboli
Rudolf, for a favor?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So my ears did not deceive me. This is
rather
unusual, I might add.
choice_data_list: I want you to run with Eishin Flash.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A fair share of Umamusume have
expressed a
desire to run with me, but
never before has a
trainer demanded I
run against their trainee.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And you believe your racer to be one of
those
few?
choice_data_list: Few Umamusume can withstand the pressure of competing against the Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh? Do tell.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash's proposition of doing
scrimmages to
build up experience isn't
bad per se. But in the
end, it just
amounts to regular practice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But if she runs against a previous Derby

champion, then she can see what it takes
to win
firsthand. That, over anything, is
true experience.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I see. That's a rather audacious
request you
ask of me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Planning to siphon my own experience
of winning
the Derby and pass it along
to her, are you? You
are quite the bold
trainer, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Intriguing. I can see you care quite
sincerely for
your racer.
choice_data_list: Because it's what's needed to win the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Something else has become clear to me
as well—it
appears Eishin Flash is getting
restless.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This may be due to her straitlaced
nature, or
perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Here is a proposition for you. I don't
mind being
Eishin Flash's opponent.
However...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The experience she requires may be of a
more
vibrant hue.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Like that of a luscious green turf, for
instance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As instructed by Symboli Rudolf, I head
to the
track after the graded races have
finished.

Whew, the races today were awesome!
So
freeing... I'm itching for more.

Thundering footsteps, sharp breaths, the

cheering... Everything I want's all here.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Don't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Just someone who loves racing... But I've
got too
much exposure for you to buy
that, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This runner charmed untold numbers of
fans with
an unforgettable running style
and claimed the
title of Triple Crown
champion, but no one has
seen her in
ages.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm Mr. C.B. Is that enough of an
introduction?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B. is a legendary Umamusume on par with Symboli Rudolf. So this is the experience she was talking about.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You're up, Mr. Trainer. I hope it's
something fun.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You're up, Ms. Trainer. I hope it's
something fun.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Partner running? Sure.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Running with someone gearing up for
the Derby
sounds like fun.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: And I'm up for fun anytime.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's the day I finally keep my
promise with
Eishin Flash.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: All right, I'll go get ready.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I shall be waiting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This opportunity to learn from one of
the best has
Eishin Flash buzzing with
energy. I'm impressed
with how
level-headed she is despite that.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I still do not understand the logic behind
running
a race "to grasp the meaning of
the Derby"... nor
how it results in gaining
experience.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, running with a Triple Crown
champion
before the Derby will surely
prove invaluable.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Will do.
choice_data_list: Go out there and run fearlessly!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their private scrimmage ends almost as
quickly as
it starts.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(...300 meters remain. C.B. is still
rounding the
corner... I can win this!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I think now's the time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice Mr. C.B. muttering something
under her
breath, and in the next
moment...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Aaand that's my win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite Eishin Flash's huge lead, Mr.
C.B.
manages to completely overtake
her with
unbelievable speed.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hey, Flash. Do you like running?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, but I don't understand the
meaning
of your question.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
There's no hidden meaning in it. I just
want to
know if you like running.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Running requires no emotion. I run
because I
must.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Then what about the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I heard you wanna be the Derby
champion. Don't
you feel anything
special toward it?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You thought you'd win today, didn't
you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Of course I knew your intentions. How
could I
not? I'm dialed in to everything.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The trick to winning the Derby is telling
yourself
that you'll win.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Channel your hunger to win into energy!
Devour
the roar of the crowd, your
opponents, your
limits, and your luck
too!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Leave it all out here—that's exactly how
hard
you'll need to run to win.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
After all, you only get one shot at the
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Do you get it yet?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, but I don't understand. You
speak of
vague sensations not grounded
in reality.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Blunt, aren't you? Well, just
ponder it a
while, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Where your running leads you is up to
you. You
can only attempt this race once
in your life. And
you know what?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see what you'll feel and
take away
from it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you for today, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To be truthful, I'm not sure. In a
practical sense, I
gained much.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Outside of that... I feel slightly strange.
The
sensation has persisted ever since
C.B. overtook
me in our race...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though she can't put it into words, I
think
Eishin Flash may have learned
something
important.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Very well.
choice_data_list: Try to remember that feeling during the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I must admit, the thought of running with
a Triple
Crown champion never occurred
to me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: That's what I'm here for, after all.
That's what I'm here for, after all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's true. I have people who are
here to
help further my growth and
provide me with
different perspectives.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I am greatly indebted to both you and
C.B.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I must repay everyone for their support
with
perfect results at the Japanese
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I cannot hear even the slightest waver of
anxiety
in her voice. She seems to have
taken an
important step toward
competing in the Japanese
Derby.
